title: Guess How Many Played One Fortnite Event at Once 🎮 #shorts
description:
Guess how many people were in one Fortnite event at the same time. Comment a number.

An in-game concert in April 2020 hit 12.3 million concurrent players, an all-time record at the time. In December 2020, an end-of-season event reached 15.3 million at once, plus 3.4 million+ watching on YouTube and Twitch. A 2024 concert got over 14 million and the big 2025 event 10.5 million, so as far as Epic has announced, the record still stands.

Sources: Epic Games via GamesRadar and PC Gamer, Wikipedia (Chapter 2 Remix), Virtwave Fortnite statistics
